title: Rūpam
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave rūpesu chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 4-8 Yo saddesu || || Yo gandhesu || || Yo rasesu || || Yo poṭṭhabbesu || || Yo dhammesu chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 9 Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno imesu chasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti || nekkhammaninnaṃ cassa cittaṃ hoti || nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittam kammaniyaṃ khāyati abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesū ti || ||
